newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's 10-month trade gap off 4.23 pct - customs.
newsitem.headline: Peru's 10-month trade gap off 4.23 pct - customs.

text.p: Peru's trade deficit fell 4.23 percent in the first ten months of the year to $1.704 billion from $1.779 billion in the same period last year, according to Customs Service figures published on Saturday.
Customs said exports in the January-October period were up 6.87 percent to $4.798 billion, while imports rose 3.72 percent to $6.502 billion.
The customs' figures do not include all the statistics used to calculate the Central Reserve Bank's official trade balance figures, which are published later.
